name: component-home
note: Composes headlessly (new Composer() registers the meta-components). `component: home` -> the home meta-component sets layout:page and emits `<PageHome {...props}/>`, dropping body prose. No source/@uniform -> no oas-to-snippet dependency, so this is a C-S4b native target (component: home => full). parity.rs enforces rendered.html when compile_mdx returns `full`.
